Musculoskeletal Diagnosis

Musculoskeletal Diagnosis

At Mumbai Ortho Clinics, we offer comprehensive diagnostic evaluation for all musculoskeletal conditions, including joint disorders, muscle injuries, ligament tears, tendon issues, bone problems, and chronic pain. Our goal is to identify the root cause of pain with precision and provide a clear treatment plan tailored to each patient.

What We Diagnose

Joint Pain & Degenerative Disorders

Conditions such as arthritis, cartilage wear, inflammation, and joint instability are assessed using advanced tools to understand their severity and impact.

Muscle & Soft Tissue Injuries

Strains, tears, spasms, and overuse injuries are evaluated through clinical tests and imaging to determine the appropriate treatment.

Ligament & Tendon Problems

Sports injuries, ligament sprains, tendonitis, and partial tears are diagnosed to prevent long-term instability or mobility issues.

Bone & Structural Abnormalities

We assess fractures, bone deformities, alignment issues, and stress injuries affecting functionality and movement.

Nerve-Related Musculoskeletal Pain

Issues such as nerve compression, radiating pain, numbness, and tingling are diagnosed to determine whether they originate from the spine, joints, or soft tissues.

Diagnostic Methods We Use

Physical Examination

Detailed movement testing, strength assessment, and pain mapping to understand the condition clinically.

Digital X-Rays

High-clarity imaging to detect fractures, joint space narrowing, deformities, and bone conditions.

Ultrasound Scanning

Real-time imaging used to evaluate soft tissue concerns like tendon injuries, fluid buildup, or inflammation.

MRI (If Required)

When deeper evaluation is needed, MRI scans help diagnose ligament tears, cartilage damage, and complex injuries.

Post-Diagnosis Treatment Planning

After identifying the exact cause of pain, we guide patients with the best treatment options — whether conservative therapy, physiotherapy, regenerative medicine, or surgical care. Our aim is to restore comfort, movement, and long-term musculoskeletal health.

Why Choose Mumbai Ortho Clinic For Musculoskeletal Diagnosis Treatment?

  • Clear, evidence-backed diagnosis to avoid guesswork.
  • Precision assessments that reveal the true source of pain.
  • Expert interpretation for faster treatment decisions.
  • Complete diagnostic support from first visit to final care plan.

Regenerative & Conservative Medicine

Regenerative & Conservative Medicine

At Mumbai Ortho Total, led by Dr. Girish Bhalerao, our Regenerative and Conservative Medicine services aim to treat musculoskeletal problems using non-surgical and biological approaches. We focus on activating the body’s own repair mechanisms, alleviating pain, and improving function through personalized, holistic care. :contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0}

Regenerative Medicine Treatments

Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP)

We use PRP injections — derived from the patient’s own blood — to stimulate healing in damaged tendons, ligaments, muscles, and joints. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}

Stem Cell Therapy

Our stem cell therapy harnesses the regenerative potential of adult stem cells to repair tissues, reduce inflammation, and support recovery in chronic orthopaedic conditions. :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}

Prolotherapy

We perform prolotherapy by injecting a natural irritant solution into injured ligaments or tendons, triggering the body’s healing process to strengthen weakened areas. :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3}

Amniotic Fluid Therapy

Amniotic fluid therapy uses the healing properties of this biologic fluid to reduce inflammation and promote tissue regeneration in musculoskeletal injuries. :contentReference[oaicite:4]{index=4}

Conservative Medicine Approaches

Medication Management

Our Conservative Medicine department offers tailored medical management using anti-inflammatory drugs, pain relievers, and muscle relaxants to control symptoms and improve mobility without immediate surgery. :contentReference[oaicite:5]{index=5}

Physical Therapy

We provide personalized physiotherapy programs, including manual therapy, therapeutic exercises, and electrotherapy, to restore strength, flexibility, and function. :contentReference[oaicite:6]{index=6}

Joint Injections

Our non-surgical injection options include corticosteroids, hyaluronic acid, and other therapies to reduce joint inflammation and pain in conditions like osteoarthritis and tendonitis. :contentReference[oaicite:7]{index=7}

Bracing & Orthotics

We prescribe custom braces, splints, and orthotic devices to support injured or weakened joints, help alignment, and relieve pain. :contentReference[oaicite:8]{index=8}

Alternative & Complementary Therapies

Our holistic care team also offers alternative therapies such as acupuncture, chiropractic care, and massage therapy as part of a comprehensive conservative treatment plan. :contentReference[oaicite:9]{index=9}

Recovery & Rehabilitation

Post-treatment, our physiotherapy and rehabilitation team collaborates closely to design recovery plans. Whether it's regenerative or conservative therapy, we emphasize improving mobility, building strength, and maintaining long-term joint health. :contentReference[oaicite:10]{index=10}

Why Choose Mumbai Ortho Clinic For Regenerative and Conservative Medicine Treatment?

  • Natural healing options that reduce pain without invasive steps.
  • Regenerative therapies designed to rebuild, not just relieve.
  • Holistic treatment programs supporting long-term joint health.
  • Ideal for patients seeking recovery with minimal downtime.
Expertise of Dr. Girish Bhalerao
Advanced Technology
Personalized Treatment Plans
Comprehensive Care
Expertise of Dr. Girish Bhalerao

With specialized training in regenerative medicine, Dr. Bhalerao offers safe, advanced, and results-driven treatments aimed at restoring mobility and preventing future injuries.

Advanced Technology

Personalized Treatment Plans

Your treatment is tailored to your condition, activity level, and recovery goals—ensuring the most effective non-surgical approach for long-term joint and soft-tissue health.

From assessment to therapy sessions, exercise guidance, and follow-ups, we provide complete conservative care to support your healing journey without surgical intervention.

Orthopaedic Oncology

Orthopaedic Oncology

At Mumbai Ortho Total, we provide specialized orthopaedic oncology care, focusing on the diagnosis, management, and surgical treatment of bone and soft-tissue tumors. Our experienced orthopedic oncology team works to deliver limb-sparing surgery, reconstruction, and comprehensive care to help patients regain function and quality of life.

Our Expertise

Bone Tumour Treatment

We manage primary bone tumors (benign and malignant) as well as secondary (metastatic) bone disease. Our approach combines imaging, biopsy, surgical excision, and reconstruction to achieve the best possible outcome while preserving function.

Soft-Tissue Sarcoma Management

Our team treats sarcomas of the soft tissue using multidisciplinary planning, surgical resection, and reconstruction. We aim to remove the tumor completely while maintaining strength, mobility, and appearance.

Limb-Salvage Surgery

Where possible, we prefer limb-salvage techniques over amputation. Using custom implants, bone grafting, and advanced fixation methods, we reconstruct limbs after tumor removal to restore shape and function.

Reconstruction & Rehabilitation

Post-tumor excision, our team plans reconstructive procedures — bone graft, prosthetic implants, or biological reconstruction. We work closely with physiotherapy specialists to design rehabilitation programs that help recover strength, mobility, and daily function.

Recovery & Follow-Up

We emphasize long-term follow-up because tumor patients need careful monitoring. Our rehabilitation team guides patients through structured physiotherapy, strength training, and functional recovery, while oncologists manage further care or adjuvant therapy.

Why Choose Mumbai Ortho Clinic For Orhopedic Oncology Treatment?

  • Specialized care for complex bone tumors with advanced technology.
  • Expertise that balances cancer treatment with mobility preservation.
  • Early detection support for better treatment success.
  • Customized tumor management plans for improved long-term outcomes.
Expertise of Dr. Girish Bhalerao
Multidisciplinary Team Approach
Advanced Diagnostics and Treatment Options
Personalized Treatment Plans
Expertise of Dr. Girish Bhalerao

With specialized training and extensive experience in Orthopedic Oncology, Dr. Bhalerao is dedicated to providing state-of-the-art, compassionate care for patients with complex musculoskeletal tumors and conditions.

Multidisciplinary Team Approach

Our Orthopedic Oncology team collaborates closely with oncologists, radiologists, pathologists, and other specialists to ensure comprehensive evaluation, accurate diagnosis, and tailored treatment plans for each patient.

Advanced Diagnostics and Treatment Options

Our modern facilities are equipped with advanced imaging technologies, including MRI, CT scans, and PET scans, as well as innovative surgical techniques, such as limb salvage surgery, tumor resection, and reconstructive procedures, to provide optimal outcomes for our patients.

Personalized Treatment Plans

We believe in individualized care and tailor our treatment plans to meet the unique needs, goals, and preferences of each patient, focusing on preserving function, improving quality of life, and achieving the best possible outcomes.

Using custom implants, bone grafting, and advanced fixation methods, we reconstruct limbs after tumor removal to restore shape and function. Paediatric Orthopaedics

Paediatric Orthopaedics

At Mumbai Ortho Total, our Paediatric Orthopaedics service provides expert care for children’s bone and joint issues, under the leadership of experienced orthopaedic surgeons. We specialize in diagnosing and treating congenital, developmental, traumatic, and growth-related orthopedic conditions in young patients.

Our Expertise

Congenital & Developmental Disorders

We manage a variety of congenital and developmental orthopedic conditions, such as clubfoot, hip dysplasia, and limb length differences, using evidence-based techniques tailored for growing children.

Trauma & Fractures in Children

Pediatric fractures require special attention due to growing bones. We treat fractures in children with non-surgical methods (casting, splints) where possible, or use pediatric-specific surgical fixation when necessary, ensuring optimal healing without affecting growth.

Growth-Related & Deformity Correction

For conditions like scoliosis, bow legs/knock knees, or other limb deformities, we offer growth modulation, guided growth surgeries, and corrective osteotomies—always prioritizing minimally invasive techniques and preserving long-term function.

Recovery & Rehabilitation

Rehabilitation for children involves careful physiotherapy, muscle strengthening, and mobility training. Our pediatric physiotherapists work closely with orthopedic surgeons to create play-based exercises and family-friendly rehab plans to ensure a safe and effective recovery.

Trauma & Fractures

Trauma & Fractures

At Mumbai Ortho Total, we provide specialized trauma care for bone injuries arising from accidents, falls, or high-impact events. Our trauma service is backed by an experienced team of orthopaedic trauma surgeons, imaging specialists, and rehabilitation experts who ensure accurate diagnosis and rapid treatment.

Our Trauma & Fracture Expertise

Emergency Trauma Care

Our trauma team offers round-the-clock emergency care, stabilizing injuries, conducting diagnostic imaging, and providing immediate surgical or non-surgical treatment as needed. This includes management of soft tissue injuries and life-threatening fractures.

Fracture Treatment

We manage all kinds of fractures — from simple hairline breaks to complex multi-fragment injuries. Our treatment options include casting, internal fixation (plates, screws, rods), and external fixation depending on the type and severity of the fracture.

Open & Complex Fractures

For open (compound) fractures and complex trauma, our team performs surgical debridement, stabilizes bone alignment, and ensures proper soft-tissue care to prevent infection and promote healthy healing.

Bone Healing & Reconstruction

In cases where fractures are complicated, non-unions or malunions may develop. We offer reconstructive surgery, bone grafting, and techniques to enhance bone healing and restore functionality.

Recovery & Rehabilitation

Recovery is supported by our physiotherapy team through tailored rehabilitation protocols that rebuild strength, mobility, and stability. We guide patients from the early healing phase to full functional recovery, aiming for the best long-term outcome.

Why Choose Mumbai Ortho Clinic For Trauma and Fractures Treatment?

  • Expert-driven fracture management for quicker stabilization.
  • Trauma care designed to preserve function and prevent complications.
  • Skilled surgical and non-surgical options for all fracture types.
  • Structured recovery plans to help you return to routine fast.

Advanced Technology

Spine Treatment

Spine Problems & Treatment

At Mumbai Ortho Clinics, under the guidance of Dr. Girish Bhalerao, we offer advanced care for a wide range of spine-related conditions. Our focus is on accurate diagnosis, minimally invasive treatment options, and restoring pain-free mobility so patients can return to their normal lifestyle.

Our Expertise in Spine Care

Disc Problems

Disc bulges and herniations can cause severe back or neck pain along with radiating symptoms. We provide advanced treatment options ranging from physiotherapy and medications to minimally invasive procedures when required.

Lumbar Canal Stenosis (LCS)

Lumbar canal stenosis results from narrowing of the spinal canal, often causing leg pain, tingling, or difficulty walking. Our approach focuses on decompression techniques, targeted physiotherapy, and progressive rehabilitation.

Degenerative Spine Conditions

Conditions such as degenerative disc disease, spinal arthritis, and spondylolisthesis are managed through a combination of lifestyle guidance, strengthening programs, injections, and surgical options when required.

Recovery & Rehabilitation

Recovery from spine conditions requires a structured physiotherapy plan focusing on flexibility, core strengthening, posture correction, and long-term spine health. Our team supports patients through every stage of their rehabilitation.

Why Choose Mumbai Ortho Clinic For Spine Treatment?

  • Spine specialists focused on relieving pain with precision.
  • Treatments that improve posture, stability, and daily comfort.
  • Minimally disruptive procedures for maximum mobility.
  • Comprehensive care for every stage of spine health.

Sports Medicine & Arthroscopy

At Mumbai Ortho Total, our Sports Medicine & Arthroscopy service specializes in diagnosing, treating, and rehabilitating sports-related injuries using minimally invasive techniques. Our expert team, led by experienced orthopedic surgeons, helps athletes and active individuals recover fully and return to peak performance.

Our Expertise

Shoulder Arthroscopy

We treat shoulder instability, rotator cuff tears, SLAP lesions, and other shoulder injuries with keyhole surgery to minimize tissue damage and speed recovery.

Knee Arthroscopy

Our knee arthroscopy services include ACL/PCL reconstruction, meniscal repair, cartilage restoration, and diagnostic arthroscopy for pain, swelling, or instability.

Miscellaneous Joint Treatments

In addition to shoulder and knee, we also treat injuries in other joints — ankle, elbow, wrist — using minimally invasive arthroscopic surgical techniques where appropriate.

Prevention & Injury Management

We emphasize injury prevention through sports-specific evaluation, strength training, and education. For acute or chronic injuries, our team combines non-surgical strategies (physiotherapy, injections) and surgical options for optimal care.

Rehabilitation & Return to Sport

Our rehabilitation protocol is tailored to each athlete, focusing on restoring strength, flexibility, and performance. We partner with physiotherapists and sports scientists to guide you through phased recovery for a safe return to your sport.

Why Choose Mumbai Ortho Clinic For Sports Medicine Treatment?

    What conditions do you treat?
    We treat joint pain, fractures, arthritis, spine issues, and sports injuries.
    Do all orthopedic problems need surgery?
    No, many are managed with medicines, physiotherapy, or lifestyle changes.
    Do you offer physiotherapy and rehabilitation?
